name: Microgrid initial reference-establishment request
aliases: microgrids Microgrid black-start and restoration controls
summary: Requests the selected source to establish the assigned island voltage and frequency reference.
description: Requests the selected source to establish the assigned island voltage and frequency reference. Black-start and restoration control coordinates the establishment of an electrical reference and the gradual return of assigned resources and loads. A dead system, an available starting source and a successful load restoration are distinct states.

In a microgrid recovering from a blackout, an available grid-forming source can establish the assigned island reference before compatible generation and eligible load groups are introduced under the validated restoration strategy. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Qualified start permission” at the input and “Reference-establishment command” at the output. The source controller governs its actual sequence.
